wire.content: Busy week here. The weather turned cold, the dog refuses to go out in the rain, and work is all quarterly reports so I barely read the news. I tried the new ramen place near the office, it was fine, nothing special. Oh, and my partner and I are expecting our first baby in March, so that is on my mind a lot. Anyway, the Raptors lost again on Tuesday. How are things on your side?
